description: Object /build (spec 19.15, 19.20): the build operations of lw build, lw clean and lw reset as task-streamed methods; the protocol-10 build, clean and reset requests stay as their v0 aliases. Each replies with the operation's outcome (accepted with the task_id, refused, declined, confirm) and streams the task on the transport's task stream.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

extra.description: Arguments passed to the build tool (after --).

clean.description: Clean the profile's build directories (lw clean [<profile>]); nothing to clean is the refused result.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

reset.description: Hard-reset build directories (lw reset [<profile> | --all] [-y], spec 16.30): without yes the result is confirm with the plan's lines and token; with yes (and that token as plan) the reset runs as a task. Nothing to reset is refused with stream out and exit code 0.

profile.description: The profile (absent: the active one), resolved as the in-process command resolves it.

interactive.description: The client can ask the user (a terminal); without it a missing profile is refused, never onboarded.

command.description: The command name the task's lines quote (lw build, ...).

all.description: Every profile's build directories (not with profile).

plan.description: The token of the confirm result the user accepted; a changed plan is refused.
